name: Ubuntu
body: robots.txt points AI crawlers to Markdown versions of pages, port 80 is closed, and the CSP starts at default-src 'self'. But the Server header reads nginx/1.14.0 (Ubuntu), naming an exact version.
lesson: Turn off version tokens (server_tokens off in nginx). Exact versions make it easy to match known flaws.
summary: ubuntu.com scores 86 out of 100 (B). 1 check fails now, 16 are at risk, and 23 pass. Fix first: 1 form control has no label.

fix.title: 1 form control has no label
fix.evidence: On /cloud/public-cloud. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Some pages are closed to AI answer crawlers
fix.evidence: OAI-SearchBot cannot read 1 page, ChatGPT-User cannot read 1 page, Claude-SearchBot cannot read 1 page, PerplexityBot cannot read 1 page.
fix.fix: Check that the closed paths are meant to stay out of AI answers.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Tag Manager appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: 1 page asks search engines not to index it
fix.fix: Remove noindex from pages that should be found, and keep it only on private or duplicate pages.

fix.title: 2 internal links go through a redirect
fix.evidence: /livepatch → /security/livepatch, /esm → /security/esm. Each hop costs crawl budget and a little speed.
fix.fix: Point the links straight at the final address.

fix.title: 2 pages do not have exactly one h1
fix.fix: Give each page one h1 that names it.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http does not serve the site
Every image has an alt attribute
Every page has a meta description
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
